archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Adapted for Indian B2B Trade
mood: Professional, Rooted, Trustworthy, Serious Trade, Data-Dense

layout_and_spacing.card_style: Flat, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default, hover: shadow-sm, rounded-md
layout_and_spacing.table_density: High-density data rows with 1px border-b, striped or clean. Use IBM Plex Sans for legibility.

components.hero_search: Prominent, centered, high-contrast. Use Shadcn Input heavily customized. Include filters (Brand, City) as dropdowns alongside the main search input.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0B1B3D] text-white hover:bg-[#1E2A4F] rounded-md px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#E65100] text-white hover:bg-[#FF6D00] rounded-md px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-colors (Use for 'Request Order')
buttons.outline: border border-[#E2E8F0] text-[#1E293B] hover:bg-[#F8F9FA] rounded-md px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

components.tables: Shadcn Table customized for data density. Crisp edges, max 4px rounding on outer container. Padded cells p-2 or p-3. Status badges with distinct colors.
components.status_badges: Small, rounded-full, px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. 'Completed/In Stock' -> bg-green-100 text-green-800. 'Pending' -> bg-amber-100 text-amber-800. 'Shipped' -> bg-blue-100 text-blue-800.
components.navigation: Solid background (white) header with 1px bottom border. Prominent logo. Role-based links. No glassmorphism here, keep it clinical and crisp.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog. Flat style, sharp corners or max 8px border-radius. Clear dark overlay (bg-black/50).

interactions.hover_states: Crisp color shifts, subtle -translate-y-[1px] for cards, clear border-color changes. Explicit hover text colors.
interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders matching exact grid dimensions. Avoid generic spinners for data tables.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. All text over images must use gradient overlay.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., 'search-input', 'order-request-button', 'supplier-login-link').

hero_background.description: Modern warehouse aisle with stacks of goods, symbolizing B2B trade and scale. Needs a dark overlay for text contrast.

category_toners.description: Close-up of a black printer toner cartridge, excellent for category or product placeholders.

supplier_dashboard_empty.description: Bright modern warehouse featuring pallets. Use as a subdued background for empty states or supplier onboarding.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use '@phosphor-icons/react' for dense dashboard and B2B iconography.
Install and use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Do not use Inter or Roboto.
Build a robust hero section on the landing page with an overriding search bar focused on toner models. The search bar is the main action.
Do not use generic purple/violet SaaS gradients. Stick to the deep Ink Blue and Amber palette. Keep it looking like a serious B2B platform.
For the Search Results, build a high-density comparison table or list view allowing buyers to see multiple suppliers, cities, stock, and price clearly.
Order request flow does not require payment processing, but must capture model, quantity, and supplier.
Implement Role-Based dashboards (Customer, Supplier, Admin) using a tight 'Control Room' grid layout.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing/landing structural layouts, and customize Shadcn components heavily for dashboard interfaces.
